code:
# See all intermediate files (GCC's -save-temps flag):
gcc -save-temps hello.c -o hello
ls *.i *.s *.o hello    # all four stages preserved
description: This command preserves the intermediate files from the C compilation pipeline.

steps.description: GCC's -save-temps flag keeps intermediate files while building hello.
ls lists the preprocessed, assembly, object, and executable files.

title: Keep compiler stages
